questions.question: On the road to Damascus, a voice from heaven called out "Saul, Saul." What did the voice ask him?

answers.text: Why do you run from Me

questions.question: Paul told King Agrippa what the prophets and Moses said would happen to the Christ. What was it?

answers.text: He would suffer and rise first from the dead
He would conquer Rome with a mighty army
He would rule forever without ever suffering

questions.question: When King Agrippa asked if Paul could make him a Christian so quickly, what did Paul wish for all who heard him?

answers.text: That they would all become what he is
That they would all set him free today
That they would all judge him fairly

questions.question: After hearing Paul's defense, King Agrippa and the others agreed that Paul had done something worthy of imprisonment. True or false?
